assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit/logo-brand. Edit this approved VoltGecko cyberpunk GECKO SYMBOL for a readable professional app header. Retain the exact gecko silhouette and pose, four feet with circular circuit pads, lightning-shaped belly detail, curved tail and recognisable eye. Remove the entire near-black navy square backdrop and all external glow completely: output actual transparent alpha, not a simulated checkerboard. Only one isolated gecko symbol, no text, no frame, no square/rounded tile. Simple crisp graphic edges, little/no gradients, generous 8% transparent clearspace. Harmonize the colors for practical accessible UI usage while preserving the cyberpunk character. LIGHT UI VARIANT: strong deep teal/navy body silhouette #14515C and circuit lines, restrained saturated cyan internal accent #00A7B5, deep magenta #AD147B lightning accent; crisp dark contours ensure excellent recognition on pale mint or white. No white square or outer glow.
